x: The race started with Nihill rushing into a comfortable lead followed by Vaughan and John Edgington (Coventry Godiva), but by the time the field had reached 10 kilos, Vaughan had cut this lead to a mere 3 secs. with Ray Hall and Bob Farley giving a good account of themselves in the middle of the field.

On a fine afternoon Paul Nihill of Surrey Walking Club, swept into an immediate lead which he steadily increased throughout the whole of the race from John Edgington, the International walker from Coventry and Peter McCullagh of Metropolitan W.C., Oxford University, and Australia.
